insurer_note: Jubilee Life Insurance Kenya. Smart Scholar, Smart Save, Faida Elimu, Faida Maisha and Fanaka are verified against official Jubilee brochures. Faida Elite, Triplex and the pension products are from Jubilee web pages. A pure term or funeral product was not found.

products.name: Smart Scholar
products.summary: Education savings plan with life cover: pays 100% of Sum Assured plus bonuses at maturity, and if the parent dies pays 50% immediately, waives future premiums and still pays the maturity benefit.
products.target_client: Parents and guardians (incl. single parents, young families) funding primary, secondary or university costs
products.how_it_works: Fixed premiums over a chosen 8 to 18 year term. Maturity: 100% Sum Assured + annual simple reversionary bonuses (up to 4% of Sum Assured a year, declared annually) + terminal bonus equal to 100% of the bonuses earned. Death of the policyholder: 50% of Sum Assured paid at once to the nominated beneficiary, premiums waived, policy continues and 100% Sum Assured plus bonuses is paid at maturity. Total and permanent disability: premiums waived and policy runs to maturity.
key_features: Annual simple reversionary bonuses up to 4% of Sum Assured
Terminal bonus = 100% of earned bonuses
Policy loan and paid-up options after two years
Surrender value after 24 months of fully paid premiums, plus accrued bonuses
Single premium option from KES 100,000
benefits: Education continues if the parent dies: 50% of Sum Assured paid immediately and premiums waived
Premiums waived on total and permanent disability
riders_options: Accidental death: additional amount equal to Sum Assured
Total and permanent disability (accident): Sum Assured in monthly instalments over 36 months
Accident hospitalisation: up to 40% of Sum Assured, maximum KES 250,000
Last expense: KES 100,000 within 48 hours (beneficiary child covered KES 50,000)
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Minimum premium KES 2,000 monthly or KES 100,000 single; minimum Sum Assured KES 200,000
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual or single premium
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Benefits may not be payable for death or disability from criminal or unlawful acts, alcohol or drug misuse, war, terrorism, riots or civil unrest, hazardous activities or dangerous sports, provoked assault or fighting. Medical report for age 54 and above and/or Sum Assured above KES 7.5 million. Benefits subject to premiums being fully paid at claim.
channels_or_distinct_points: Apply via callback request, SMS 'Smart Scholar' to 24464, or branch
Documents: ID, KRA PIN, application form
analysis_selling_points: Strongest parent-dies story in the Jubilee education range: 50% paid at once, premiums waived, maturity still paid
Low KES 2,000 entry with fixed premiums for budgeting
Bonus plus terminal bonus gives a visible maturity growth path
Single premium option for bonuses or lump sums
analysis_watch_outs: Bonuses are declared, not guaranteed; up to 4% is a ceiling
Entry age capped at 50 and maturity age at 68, so older guardians are excluded
Surrender value only after 24 months of paid premiums, so early exit is costly
Riders cost extra
products.source_note: Verified against the official Jubilee brochure/flier supplied by the Jubilee team (Nov 2026).

products.name: Faida Elimu Insurance Plan
products.summary: Investment-linked education fund: premiums go to a managed fund and 100% of the fund value is paid at maturity, with premium waiver on death or total and permanent disability.
products.target_client: Parents of children aged 0 to 18 wanting disciplined education savings with protection
products.how_it_works: Premiums from KES 5,000 monthly or a KES 100,000 single premium go into a managed fund over a 5 to 15 year term, with top-ups at any time. Maturity pays 100% of fund value. Death or total and permanent disability waives future premiums and the policy stays in force (not for single premium policies). A KES 100,000 last expense benefit is paid within 48 hours.
key_features: Fund management fee 4%; KES 600 per partial withdrawal
Top-ups at any time
Partial withdrawals of 10% a year after 2 years; full withdrawal allowed from year one
Early-withdrawal charges: you receive 85% / 90% / 95% of fund value in policy year 1 / 2 / 3 for regular premium (90% / 95% / 97.5% for single premium), 100% from month 37
Premium payment term aligned to the policy term
benefits: Education fund keeps building if the parent dies or is disabled (waiver)
Liquidity: partial and full withdrawal options
riders_options: Waiver of premium (death or total and permanent disability); extra premium calculated from age and payment term
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: KES 5,000 monthly or KES 100,000 single premium
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, yearly or single premium, plus top-ups
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Only accidental death is covered in the first 6 months; all causes afterwards. Waiver subject to premiums being up to date; medical report if waiver benefit exceeds KES 10 million and/or age 55 and above. Past performance is no guarantee of future returns.
channels_or_distinct_points: Callback form, SMS 'Elimu' to 24464, or branch
Launched around April 2026 per press coverage
analysis_selling_points: Fund value is fully yours at maturity, with flexible withdrawals
Wide age range 18 to 65 including grandparents and guardians
Waiver keeps the education fund funded if the parent dies
analysis_watch_outs: Returns are not guaranteed
4% fund management fee and early-withdrawal haircuts reduce value in the first 3 years
The waiver premium is charged on top of the fund premium
Higher KES 5,000 entry than Smart Scholar
products.source_note: Verified against the official Jubilee brochure/flier supplied by the Jubilee team (Nov 2026).

products.name: Smart Save
products.summary: Goal-based savings plan with life cover: 100% Sum Assured plus bonuses paid at maturity or on death.
products.target_client: Individuals 18 to 65 wanting disciplined savings with protection
products.how_it_works: Fixed premiums over 5 to 20 years. Maturity and death both pay 100% of Sum Assured plus accrued simple reversionary bonuses (up to 4% of Sum Assured a year, declared annually) plus a terminal bonus of 100% of those bonuses. Death benefit is paid immediately to the nominated beneficiary.
key_features: Savings periods of 5 to 20 years
Annual simple reversionary bonuses up to 4% of Sum Assured
Terminal bonus = 100% of earned bonuses
Policy loans and paid-up options after two years
Surrender value after 24 months of fully paid premiums
benefits: Full Sum Assured plus bonuses on death, not only at maturity
Disciplined saving for a car, home, degree or business
riders_options: Total and permanent disability (accident): Sum Assured over 36 months
Waiver of premiums on total and permanent disability (accident or illness)
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Minimum premium KES 2,000 monthly or KES 100,000 single; minimum Sum Assured KES 200,000
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual or single premium
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Benefits may not be payable for death or disability from criminal or unlawful acts, alcohol or drug misuse, war and terrorism, hazardous activities, provoked assault or fighting. Medical report for age 54 and above and/or Sum Assured above KES 7.5 million; premium adjusted if results show higher risk. Subject to premiums being fully paid at claim.
channels_or_distinct_points: Callback, SMS 'Smart Save' to 24464, or branch
analysis_selling_points: Simple message: pay a fixed amount, get 100% Sum Assured plus bonuses whether you live or die
Wide entry age 18 to 65 suits most working adults
Low entry point makes it a good first policy
analysis_watch_outs: Bonuses declared annually, not guaranteed
Surrender value only after 24 months
Waiver of premium is a rider, not included by default
Brochure heading for optional benefits names Smart Scholar by mistake; confirm rider terms in the policy document
products.source_note: Verified against the official Jubilee brochure/flier supplied by the Jubilee team (Nov 2026).

products.name: Fanaka Investment Plan
products.summary: Fixed-premium savings plan with layered benefits by term: survival benefit above the Sum Assured, and a death benefit during the term.
products.target_client: Individuals saving for a home, car, ceremonies or business seed capital
products.how_it_works: Fixed premiums for a 5 to 20 year term. Layer 1 (5 to 10 years): maturity pays 110% of Sum Assured plus accrued bonus; death during the term pays 75% of Sum Assured plus accrued bonus. Layer 2 (11 to 20 years): maturity pays 120% of Sum Assured plus accrued bonus; death during the term pays 175% of Sum Assured plus double the accrued bonus; death after the premium-paying term pays 100% of Sum Assured plus accrued bonus.
key_features: Sum Assured and premiums fixed at the start
Saving period 5 to 20 years
Used as an alternative to borrowing for a home, car, ceremony or business seed capital
benefits: Higher death benefit on terms of 11 to 20 years
riders_options: Total and permanent disability (accident): Sum Assured over 36 months
Accident hospitalisation: up to 40% of Sum Assured, maximum KES 250,000
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Minimum Sum Assured KES 350,000, no maximum
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Medical report if Sum Assured exceeds KES 3,000,000. Full exclusions are in the policy document.
channels_or_distinct_points: Page links to a separate 'How to Make Payments' section
analysis_selling_points: Longer terms (11 to 20 years) give much richer benefits: 120% at maturity and 175% plus double bonus on death
Positioned as a disciplined alternative to a loan
Fixed premium makes budgeting easy
analysis_watch_outs: Short terms (5 to 10 years) pay only 75% of Sum Assured plus bonus on death, so tell clients plainly
Minimum Sum Assured of KES 350,000 is higher than Smart Save or Smart Scholar
Brochure gives no minimum premium or bonus rate; use the official illustration
products.source_note: Verified against the official Jubilee brochure/flier supplied by the Jubilee team (Nov 2026).

products.name: Faida Maisha Insurance Plan
products.summary: Universal plan combining whole life cover (KES 1 million to 200 million) with a flexible investment fund, plus a KES 100,000 last expense benefit.
products.target_client: Business owners, professionals, parents/providers and high earners
products.how_it_works: Two layers: a whole life cover premium paid for 5 to 15 years, and an investment fund funded from KES 5,000 monthly or KES 100,000 single (no maximum). Death benefit = last expense benefit + whole life cover + 100% of fund value. Fund value can be withdrawn partly or fully after the premium-paying term.
key_features: Whole life cover from KES 1,000,000 to KES 200 million
Fund management fee 4%; KES 600 per partial withdrawal
Early-withdrawal charges in the first 36 months (85% to 95% of fund value for regular premium; 90% to 97.5% for single premium)
One partial withdrawal a year, up to 10% of fund value, during the premium-paying term
Top-ups and ad hoc premiums
benefits: Lifelong cover plus growing fund in one plan
Maturity: partial or full withdrawal of fund value any time after the premium-paying term
products.term_or_duration: Premium paying term 5 to 15 years; cover for life
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Fund from KES 5,000 monthly or KES 100,000 single; whole life cover from KES 1,000,000
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, yearly or single premium, plus top-ups
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Only accidental death is covered in the first 6 months. Cover is subject to premiums being fully paid at claim. Medical report if whole life cover exceeds KES 10 million and/or age 55 and above. Whole life premiums are paid in addition to the fund premium.
analysis_selling_points: Combines legacy cover and wealth building, a natural fit for higher-income families and business owners
Very high cover ceiling (up to KES 200 million)
Fund value is added to the death benefit
analysis_watch_outs: Two premiums to explain (cover and fund)
Fund returns not guaranteed; 4% management fee
Withdrawal limits during the premium-paying term
Cover lapses in effect if whole life premiums stop
products.source_note: Verified against the official Jubilee brochure/flier supplied by the Jubilee team (Nov 2026).

Annual fund management fee and mortality charge
